player_intent: Long gameplay and repeated weapon comparison remain responsive without progressive animation cost, duplicate IK modifiers, stale animation caches, or debug-input error floods.
acceptance_rule: The zero-weight legacy locomotion graph does not advance while the modern route owns presentation. Repeated AK/M4 swaps reuse exactly one combat-ready modifier. Public or restricted play may omit developer-only telemetry input without producing errors. The packaged operator library must match the current animation-map fingerprint before release. Canonical idle, movement, and fire frame times remain stable without recurring 20 ms hitches.

nodes.role: Evaluates only the selected modern or legacy locomotion route instead of advancing a hidden zero-weight graph.
Keeps one modifier attached to the operator skeleton and replaces only its weapon contact data on equipment changes.
Observes the developer telemetry shortcut only when its optional InputMap action exists, preventing per-event error spam in public play.
Forces --build-animation-cache to process the canonical animation map and publish a fresh project cache instead of returning early after adopting a user cache.

must_not_change: SOCOM camera and reticle aim authority
server shot, ballistics, damage, and network authority
selected animation route timing or visible playback semantics
developer telemetry recording behavior when F11 is registered

system_delta.reason: Replace hidden duplicate graph evaluation, repeated modifier allocation, unguarded optional debug input, existence-only cache checks, process-order-dependent StringName hashes, and no-op packaged-cache builds with one active route, one reused modifier, a bounded input guard, deterministic cache fingerprint validation, and forced canonical cache publication in build mode.

current.system: Duplicate hidden animation evaluation with accumulating equipment modifiers, optional-input error spam, and a potentially stale packaged cache

candidate.system: Single-route animation evaluation with stable modifier lifetime, guarded optional telemetry input, and current fingerprinted animation cache

visual_check: Run res://main.tscn through idle, movement, accepted fire recovery, and repeated AK/M4 equipment swaps. Confirm stable frame pacing, exactly one CombatReadySpineCCDIK3D, no missing-input errors in public mode, and no visible change when the inactive legacy animation route is frozen.
